top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Sovev Jerusalem's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at Sovev Jerusalem. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 31 miles.
At Sovev Jerusalem, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Sovev Jerusalem's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
31 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Sovev Jerusalem. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Sovev Jerusalem. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Torque for headwinds and mixed terrain. When cadence drops below 70rpm, muscular strength keeps the watts up.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Sovev Jerusalem's mixed terrain actually does to you.

race_overlay.weather: May in Jerusalem, Israel. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Sovev Jerusalem. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan that matches the ride duration, intensity, and weather. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Sovev Jerusalem. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, VO2max, and Road Specific to prepare you for 31 miles of mixed terrain in Jerusalem, Israel.
